title: Expense Agent: capture submission policy evaluation history
summary: Expense Agent now captures policy evaluation history at the report level, storing outcomes and flagged categories in the activity log during submission and resubmission with deduplication per submission round.
key_points: Report-level policy evaluation summaries are added to expense activity history
Submission, resubmission and successful line evaluation confirmation invoke the history logger
At most one PolicyEvaluated entry is written per submission round, only when policy evaluation is enabled and the report is pending approval
Entries store the outcome, passed/failed counts and distinct flagged category codes, with a final '...' entry on overflow
Snapshots are exposed through the existing read-only activity API and preserved through posting
quote: Adds report-level policy evaluation summaries to expense activity history.
